name: How do I choose a contractor for a luxury attached home addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for a luxury attached home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a luxury attached home addition, prioritize those with extensive experience in high-end residential projects and a strong portfolio demonstrating similar work. Look for licensed, insured, and reputable companies with transparent communication, a detailed proposal process, and excellent client references. A contractor who understands luxury aesthetics, manages complex projects efficiently, and prioritizes quality craftsmanship will best deliver your vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with extensive luxury residential experience, a strong portfolio, transparent communication, and excellent references to ensure quality and expertise.
